edition_fence.meaning: The edition owner records a source-backed fence preventing an old exact operation execution generation from appending at its previous expected stream position.

initial_label_requested.meaning: The edition with an unavailable initial label records a new operation selecting a replacement initial label; the new label is not yet claimed.

initial_label_refused.meaning: The edition records that its exact initial label selection was definitively refused or fenced; no label is confirmed.

creation_cancelled.meaning: The edition owner commits cancellation of an initial draft-creation attempt before it becomes ready; delayed claim outcomes must not reactivate it.

rename_requested.meaning: The edition owner records a requested draft label change, including old and new labels, before the new claim is confirmed.

draft_renamed.meaning: The edition owner commits a change from the old label generation to a reserved new label generation; the new claim confirmation is still pending.

rename_completed.meaning: The edition owner records that the new label claim has been confirmed against its committed label change; old label cleanup may still be pending.

rename_refused.meaning: The edition owner records a terminal refusal for one exact requested rename; its prior label remains current.

rename_cancelled.meaning: The edition owner records cancellation of one exact rename before the edition label-change fact commits.

draft_abandoned.meaning: The edition owner commits the terminal abandonment of one unpublished draft, preventing later publication; claim cleanup is separate.

summary_corrected.meaning: An individual criterion or point of focus has its original product-authored summary corrected; the published structural membership does not change.

entry_fenced.meaning: An entry owner records a source-backed execution-generation fence so an earlier unresolved entry operation cannot rebase and append later.
